verdict.rationale: Perplexity's own docs repeatedly say the Search API returns real-time, ranked web results with 'advanced filtering', which supports the freshness half of the story. However, the only filters actually named are domains, languages, regions and content extraction; no date-range or recency filter appears in the evidence. missing for 10: documented date-range filter parameters, documented recency filter (e.g., last day/week), evidence on index update frequency, independent or hands-on corroboration of freshness.
